summary: Assess AS/RS, AGV and AMR use cases, integration needs and safety considerations. Explore the warehouse automation course and plan your next steps.
lede: Warehouse automation training helps operations managers, engineers and project leads assess use cases and plan system integration. Learners map receiving, storage, picking and dispatch flows, estimate throughput and capacity, compare AS/RS, AGV and AMR applications, and document WMS, WES and WCS interface needs; they also develop acceptance measures and a phased readiness plan, with safety references informing their review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, specify, operate or govern warehouse automation and need to connect equipment choices with warehouse processes, system interfaces and operating measures.
